note: Routing benchmark for v0.3 (software changes where diagnosis, scope, abstractions, contracts, boundaries, or test oracles matter vs. informational requests and routine mechanical edits). 4 explicit, 16 implicit positive, and 16 implicit negative prompts. Prompts are independent of the 5 holdout fixtures.

explicit.prompt: Use $pragmatic-craftsman to fix this one-line retry bug.
/pragmatic-craftsman decide whether this repository abstraction is worth adding.
@pragmatic-craftsman review and fix the tenant boundary in service.py.
Use the pragmatic-craftsman skill to add unit tests for shipping_cents.
